title: Private backups: add S3 + KMS module wiring, least-privilege IAM policies, and VPC endpoint notes
author: Bruno Silva
description:
Context: As part of the Day-2 ops toolkit for Redwood Private (backup/restore), we need a repeatable Terraform pattern for provisioning an encrypted backup target in customer VPCs. This PR introduces a small, composable module and examples that wire up: (1) an S3 bucket for backup artifacts, (2) a dedicated KMS key and key policy that supports customer ownership + optional break-glass restore, (3) least-privilege IAM policies/roles for the backup job identity, and (4) notes for running fully private (no public egress) using S3 VPC Gateway Endpoints (or PrivateLink where applicable).

What’s included: Adds module `modules/private_backup_bucket` that provisions an S3 bucket with default SSE-KMS encryption, versioning, lifecycle/retention primitives, and guardrails (deny non-TLS; deny incorrect encryption headers). Creates an opinionated KMS key + alias with policy statements for: cluster backup role, restore role, and optional admin/break-glass principal (disabled by default; documented pattern). Adds `examples/private-backups/` showing an end-to-end wiring for a typical Redwood Private EKS-in-VPC deployment, including IAM policy snippets suitable for `rw-private-dr backup create` and scheduled CronJobs. Documents VPC gateway endpoint requirements and common pitfalls (bucket policy with `aws:sourceVpce`, cross-account KMS, and STS regional endpoints).

Security notes: The backup role is restricted to a single bucket ARN and prefixes; KMS permissions are scoped to the key created by the module. By default the module blocks public access, enables bucket owner enforced object ownership, and uses a minimal bucket policy surface area. The module does not attempt to manage customer org-wide SCPs or guardrails.

Out of scope: No cross-region replication (tracked separately in PR #327 / ENG-??). No GCS/Azure backends here.

Testing: `terraform fmt` and `validate` pass; `tflint` with aws rules passes. Included a simple CI smoke apply for the example with localstack-disabled (plan-only) to ensure no syntax drift.

Rollout: This is additive. Existing Private installs can adopt the example in-place. Docs note that switching KMS keys on an existing bucket is not supported; create a new bucket/key and update backup config instead.

References: ENG-4860 (Terraform examples for VPC + KMS wiring), ENG-4834 (storage target support matrix).

review_conversation: 2025-11-08 Diego Santos: The module layout looks good. Can we make the IAM policy prefix explicit (e.g., `backups/${var.cluster_id}/`) so customers don't accidentally share buckets across clusters with the same role?
2025-11-08 Bruno Silva (author): Yep. I’ll add `backup_prefix` as an input with a safe default and scope `s3:PutObject`/`GetObject`/`ListBucket` conditions accordingly.

2025-11-09 Marcus Lin: KMS policy: please avoid `kms:*` for the backup role. Also, can we add a deny in the bucket policy for requests missing `x-amz-server-side-encryption` or using AES256? That’s been a common review item.
2025-11-09 Bruno Silva (author): Agreed. Updated KMS permissions to `Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/DescribeKey` only. Bucket policy now enforces `aws:kms` and checks the key ARN.

2025-11-10 Sean Gallagher: Add a short section in the example README for "Private clusters" explaining gateway endpoint vs public S3 access. We see customers block egress and then hit timeouts; calling this out will reduce tickets.
2025-11-10 Bruno Silva (author): Added a "No public egress" section with required endpoints + DNS notes, plus a troubleshooting snippet for 403 vs timeout to separate IAM from networking.

2025-11-11 Connor O'Brien: Minor: can we keep variable names consistent with the installer docs (`backup_bucket_name`, `backup_kms_key_arn`)? Also please pin AWS provider constraints in the example so customers don't get surprised by `ObjectOwnership` behavior changes.
2025-11-11 Bruno Silva (author): Renamed example outputs to match naming, left module inputs generic. Added provider constraint note in the example README and pinned to `>= 5.0` in the example.
2025-11-12 Marcus Lin: Re-reviewed. Looks good after the KMS scoping and encryption enforcement. Approved.
2025-11-12 Diego Santos: Approved. Prefix scoping and endpoint notes address my concerns.
2025-11-12 Sean Gallagher: Approved. This will help a lot with Private installs in restricted VPCs.
release_notes: Add Terraform module and example for encrypted S3 backup bucket + KMS wiring for Redwood Private backup/restore tooling.
Provide least-privilege IAM policies for backup and restore job identities.
Document VPC gateway endpoint configuration and private networking pitfalls for S3 backups.
